assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a small, real embroidered play symbol for an illustrator's website. EDIT THE SUPPLIED TRANSPARENT EMBROIDERY FRAME IMAGE: keep the identical bright cornflower / azure blue (#2086F9) thread, its soft fibers, irregular handmade 2-ply twists and natural highlights; completely rearrange its stitches into ONE compact RIGHT-POINTING triangle (▶), seen straight down, on a transparent SQUARE canvas. Remove the rectangle entirely. The new symbol consists purely of 10 to 12 separate, gently wavy, almost-horizontal lengths of that same fine matte yarn. Each row is one single continuous unbroken strand, left to right, from a slightly uneven common vertical left edge. Strand lengths start very short at the top, grow gradually to the single longest strand at the center pointing right, then shrink to very short at the bottom. Close spacing with a hairline of genuine transparency visible between rows. Width about 90% of the triangle's height; centered with a modest transparent margin. Keep subdued dimensional embroidery texture, minuscule real fraying and slight changes in thread tension, just like the supplied stitches, readable at a 42px display size. Neatly tucked-in ends, no loops, no tassels, no triangular outline, no circle, no badge, no backing textile, no frame, no cast shadow outside the yarn, no straight digital bars, no text. Output a genuine high-quality transparent RGBA cutout; clear alpha both around the icon and in the slivers between its rows.
